hardSemanticBoundary.roadGeometry: OSM highway LineStrings are external mapped road/path observations, generally centerline-like. They are not surveyed road-edge polygons and do not imply physical width.
hardSemanticBoundary.buildingGeometry: OSM building/building:part geometry is external mapped footprint/part evidence. A polygon does not imply known height, levels, roof or material.

requiredCorrectionsBeforePermanentReleas.timestamp: The acquisition report incorrectly grouped numeric OSM timestamp attributes by their first four digits, producing impossible pseudo-years. Permanent release must recompute timestamps as Unix seconds or supported ISO values and preserve the original report only as superseded evidence.
requiredCorrectionsBeforePermanentReleas.buildingIdentity: The acquisition dedupe key included geometry type. Permanent release must audit unique OSM type+id identities across geometry representations and report how many LineString/MultiPolygon records are alternate representations of the same mapped object.
requiredCorrectionsBeforePermanentReleas.visualCandidatePolicy: Road visualization may use highway LineStrings as styled centerlines only; style width is not physical width. Building visualization may use polygon footprint observations only; no default extrusion. Explicit height/levels may be displayed only as separately tagged evidence, never filled by defaults.

promotionRule: Do not create R3.5 visual road widths or building volumes until the permanent source-locked evidence archive has passed timestamp correction, identity audit, payload re-verification, and explicit missing-tag semantics.
